evidence.sql:
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM valid_utc) AS BIGINT) AS valid_epoch, pm25_hour, pm25_24h, api, p_close, smoke_index
       FROM projections WHERE run_id = 'fw-2026100812-h-c439d3' AND town = 'Klang'
        AND valid_utc >= CAST('2026-10-09T00:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) AND valid_utc < CAST('2026-10-09T04:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY valid_utc

SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS hours, AVG(pm25) AS mean_pm25, MAX(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM valid_utc) AS BIGINT)) AS latest_epoch FROM pm25
      WHERE town = 'Klang' AND valid_utc > CAST('2026-10-07T12:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) AND valid_utc <= CAST('2026-10-08T12:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP)
      GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

SELECT band, api_min, api_max, action, heavy_work, version, status FROM guidance
      WHERE guidance_id = 'outdoor-work' AND version = '0.1-placeholder' ORDER BY api_min

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM valid_utc) AS BIGINT) AS valid_epoch FROM projections
        WHERE run_id = 'fw-2026100812-h-c439d3' AND town = 'Klang' AND pm25_hour IS NOT NULL
          AND valid_utc >= CAST('2026-10-09T00:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) AND valid_utc < CAST('2026-10-09T04:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY valid_utc

limitations: Guidance outdoor-work v0.1-placeholder is a PLACEHOLDER written for this demo, not official DOSH guidance.
Hourly API is an indicative hourly equivalent; official APIMS readings are 24-hour averages.
No evidence for 09:00-12:00 MYT (2026-10-09): that part of the shift is not planned. Re-check when a newer forecast arrives.
Future hours use archived model values (hindsight), as in a replay or the offline sample: a test of the method, not a true forecast.
